017package org.apache.juneau.rest.server.filter;
018
019/**
020 * Why a {@link RequestBoundary} refused a request.
021 *
022 * <p>
023 * Enumerated rather than collapsed into a single "forbidden" so the application can render an accurate reason and log
024 * an actionable one.  Distinguishing missing from mismatched leaks nothing a cross-origin caller does not already know
025 * about its own request.
026 *
027 * <p>
028 * The constant names are wire codes: {@link RequestBoundaryFilter} sends them in the
029 * {@link RequestBoundaryFilter#REJECTION_HEADER} response header and in the rejection body's {@code reason}, and page
030 * scripts match on them.  A name, once shipped, does not change.  Each constant notes the status a boundary answers
031 * it with; the status travels on the {@link BoundaryResult}, not on this enum.
032 *
033 * <h5 class='section'>See Also:</h5><ul>
034 *    <li class='jc'>{@link BoundaryResult}
035 *    <li class='jc'>{@link RequestBoundary}
036 * </ul>
037 *
038 * @since 10.0.0
039 */
040public enum BoundaryReason {
041
042   /**
043    * The {@code Host} header was absent or was not the configured authority.
044    *
045    * <p>
046    * Answered with 421 Misdirected Request, on every request.  Emitted by {@link LoopbackBoundary}, which pins one
047    * authority.
048    */
049   HOST_MISMATCH,
050
051   /** The {@code Host} header was absent.  Answered with 400 Bad Request. */
052   HOST_MISSING,
053
054   /** The {@code Host} header could not be parsed as a host and optional port.  Answered with 400 Bad Request. */
055   HOST_MALFORMED,
056
057   /** The {@code Host} header parsed, but is not one of the configured allowed hosts.  Answered with 421 Misdirected Request. */
058   HOST_NOT_ALLOWED,
059
060   /** A state-changing request carried no {@code Origin} header.  Answered with 403 Forbidden. */
061   ORIGIN_MISSING,
062
063   /**
064    * A state-changing request carried the literal {@code Origin} value {@code null}, which browsers send for opaque
065    * origins such as a sandboxed frame.  Answered with 403 Forbidden.
066    */
067   ORIGIN_NULL,
068
069   /** A state-changing request's {@code Origin} was not this server's origin.  Answered with 403 Forbidden. */
070   ORIGIN_MISMATCH,
071
072   /**
073    * A state-changing request's {@code Sec-Fetch-Site} was present and was not {@code same-origin}.  Answered with
074    * 403 Forbidden.
075    */
076   FETCH_SITE_NOT_SAME_ORIGIN,
077
078   /**
079    * A state-changing request with no {@code Origin} and no fetch metadata was one a cross-origin page could send
080    * without a preflight.  Answered with 403 Forbidden.
081    */
082   SIMPLE_REQUEST_WITHOUT_ORIGIN,
083
084   /** A state-changing request's content type was not {@code application/json}.  Answered with 415 Unsupported Media Type. */
085   CONTENT_TYPE_NOT_JSON,
086
087   /** A state-changing request carried no CSRF token header.  Answered with 403 Forbidden. */
088   CSRF_TOKEN_MISSING,
089
090   /** A state-changing request's CSRF token was not the expected token.  Answered with 403 Forbidden. */
091   CSRF_TOKEN_MISMATCH,
092
093   /**
094    * {@link CsrfBoundary.Builder#trustedForwarding(CsrfBoundary.ForwardedSource) Trusted forwarding} is on and the
095    * request carried no forwarded host (or, for {@code Forwarded}, no usable element).  Answered with 403 Forbidden.
096    */
097   FORWARDED_HOST_MISSING,
098
099   /** Trusted forwarding is on and the request carried a forwarded host but no forwarded proto.  Answered with 403 Forbidden. */
100   FORWARDED_PROTO_MISSING,
101
102   /**
103    * Trusted forwarding is on and the forwarded host, or the {@code Forwarded} header, was malformed.  Answered with
104    * 403 Forbidden.  Also used when the order of the header's lines cannot be established (a handshake map that holds
105    * the name under more than one spelling, or a container that will not enumerate the lines).
106    */
107   FORWARDED_HOST_MALFORMED,
108
109   /**
110    * Trusted forwarding is on and the forwarded proto was not {@code http} or {@code https}.  Answered with 403
111    * Forbidden.  Also used when the order of the proto header's lines cannot be established (see
112    * {@link #FORWARDED_HOST_MALFORMED}).
113    */
114   FORWARDED_PROTO_MALFORMED,
115
116   /** Trusted forwarding is on and the forwarded header held fewer entries than the trusted hop count.  Answered with 403 Forbidden. */
117   FORWARDED_HOPS_INSUFFICIENT,
118
119   /** Trusted forwarding is on and the forwarded host and proto held different numbers of entries.  Answered with 403 Forbidden. */
120   FORWARDED_HOPS_MISMATCH,
121
122   /**
123    * Trusted forwarding is on and the container's own view of the request disagrees with the forwarded origin.
124    * Answered with 403 Forbidden.
125    */
126   FORWARDED_CONTAINER_MISMATCH,
127
128   /**
129    * Trusted forwarding is on with a {@link CsrfBoundary.Builder#trustedProxies(String...) peer allow-list}, and a
130    * forwarded host arrived from a peer that is not on it (or whose address the container did not report).
131    * Answered with 403 Forbidden.
132    */
133   FORWARDED_PEER_NOT_TRUSTED
134}
